method.question_type: JEV Choice with balanced fixed options including open
method.variants: Three independently worded, equivalent requests per group with unchanged verified state, fixed outcomes and candidate descriptions; option order rotated.
method.limits: Repeated wording variants are not independent empirical evidence or a calibrated correctness vote. Reported probabilities/confidence are model judgments. No reasoning text was returned; explanatory interpretation below is by the root agent.
method.comparison_stage: All architectures are draft designs. User requirements are fixed, alternative integration mechanisms remain proposed.

disagreement_investigation: Each triplet has identical source facts, outcomes and option descriptions. Variant 1 asks whether a draft resolves the required outcome with concrete prerequisites; variant 2 asks for the smallest complete choice; variant 3 asks for the best balance at the declared draft stage. Variant 3 is more willing to choose a concrete draft in these results. Wording and ordering both varied, so neither is isolated as a cause.

Seven subchoices have the same selection in all three requests: five concrete recommendations and two open selections. Eighteen split. Do not pick a winner by majority or replace prior user requirements with these judgments.
Current analysis NodeKey uses process-local file/span/kind, never persisted: independent tracked IDs and explicit ambiguous rebind/copy handling remain needed.

Full HandlerContext exposes StoragePort while CanonicalEffectsScope stages writes and projects reads. A narrow async facade and a resumable request protocol both require canonical evaluation, result codecs and lifetime checks; flat effects collected after execution are not an equivalent solution.

Admission of module imports does not contain arbitrary JS globals or prove declared effects. Trusted application code and separate execution must be assessed against an explicitly chosen threat/authority contract; neither is silently adopted.

The current write_file_atomic helper stages and checks per-file replacement but explicitly states the final check is not a CAS. A journal or two directory renames cannot alone satisfy concurrent-edit preservation and prevent mixed group reads. A concrete writer/build-reader contract is still required.

Normal CSS inheritance, shared rules and parent geometry can couple independently owned styles. Selector scoping is not a guarantee of visual independence; the remaining choice must state permitted inherited values and boundary-root rules.

Existing same-module row-bound view/show is a concrete starting point, not arbitrary props/slots/exports. Decide the finite input scope rather than treating a broad custom component API as already supplied.
These findings identify concrete remaining design choices. They do not require a broader verification framework, rejection of the feature or further JEV calls until a preferred answer appears.

decisions.fixed_outcome: Exact Can value/contracts visible to compiler/runtime consumers; typed owning declaration and accepted implementation association; no separately authored parallel schema authority.

options.generated_contributions: Owning local modifier/target accepts saved compiler-visible declaration contributions attributed to that source unit; analyze them before generating/checking dependent JS and derive one canonical schema. Concise modifier authoring; needs generated-source attribution/hygiene/conflict and current-byte acceptance, not an independent authored manifest.

decisions.label: JavaScript effects interface
decisions.fixed_outcome: Authorized reads interleaved with staged writes/read-after-write; precise order, canonical actions/effects, rollback, one commit/replay. Pure rules have no effects.

options.narrow_facade: Validated inputs plus per-invocation narrow async methods delegating to canonical producers, no raw store/registry/commit/principal, exact result codecs. Natural JS; allowed-call/lifetime checks and separate ambient-JS trust decision needed.
options.resumable_effects: Implementation yields typed effect requests, engine performs them in order over staged overlay and resumes with admitted results; validates final result. Explicit effects/no raw capability objects; continuation/error/cancel protocol complexity and separate trust decision.
options.open: Leave this precise choice open if none meets the same outcomes; identify the needed concrete design/prerequisite in subsequent human/agent analysis. This is not rejection of the feature or permission to invent a broader obligation.

decisions.label: JavaScript execution trust
decisions.fixed_outcome: No silent extra storage authority; preserve supported canonical contracts and honestly state residual arbitrary-JS globals/hidden-effect risk. Imports/types/examples alone are not containment.

options.trusted_application: Accept JS as trusted application/workspace code using whichever finite declared execution ABI is selected (facade or resumable effects), admitted dependencies and finite checks. No raw context/bindings. Minimal host work; explicitly not an adversarial sandbox and ambient globals/dependencies can still perform undeclared effects.
options.separate_execution: Separately configured execution environment without storage/binding credentials, bridging whichever finite declared execution ABI is selected through a canonical channel, with explicit permitted ambient/network/resource controls. Reduced ambient authority; new hosting/transport/lifecycle, precise configured boundary still must be qualified.
options.open: Leave this precise choice open if none meets the same outcomes; identify the needed concrete design/prerequisite in subsequent human/agent analysis. This is not rejection of the feature or permission to invent a broader obligation.

decisions.root_interpretation: Two trusted-application preferences, one open; insufficient to settle containment. Accepting application JS with a finite ABI is not an adversarial sandbox; ambient globals/imports still need a declared trust contract.

decisions.fixed_outcome: Existing declaration-derived descriptors remain one authority; no runtime JS-created parallel registry or hidden operation.

options.compiler_wrappers: Compiler emits canonical callable/component wrappers importing selected saved exports, boundary-checking and supplying chosen ABI. Reuse current consumer paths; new wrapper/export/target lowering.
options.loader_attachments: Canonical descriptors reference derived implementation attachments checked on runtime load; private lookup maps locations only, not grants. Centralize attachment checks; loader/assembly/component target contracts change.
options.open: Leave this precise choice open if none meets the same outcomes; identify the needed concrete design/prerequisite in subsequent human/agent analysis. This is not rejection of the feature or permission to invent a broader obligation.

options.multi_source_maps: One multi-source map includes current JS bodies and Can wrapper/declaration sources plus owner metadata. Unified debugging; explicit multi-source consumer/schema support still needed.

options.fixture_overlay: Overlay candidate into relevant existing app fixture, precheck interface and run affected actual-target invocation/browser cases. Direct composition/lifecycle evidence; potentially broader cost and fixture adequacy.

groups.title: D6 Agent protocol and promotion
verified_context: Current generator protocol/promotion unimplemented. Required direct-editable tracked primary code, selected candidates, matching inputs/current bytes and no partially consumed group.

compiler/src/cli.rs1450-1505 write_file_atomic is staged per-file replacement; comment explicitly says final check is not a CAS and no durability promise. Reuse only as primitive, not group atomicity proof.

Both draft filesystem promotion schemes require a concrete bounded selected-unit mutation freeze/cooperative writer protocol and coordinated build-read gate. Prechecks/advisory locks alone do not guarantee no-overwrite against uncooperative arbitrary external writers between comparison and replacement. This gap is part of the decision, not assumed solved.

decisions.label: Agent request/result protocol
decisions.fixed_outcome: Stable schema IDs/request IDs/explicit selected units, JSON or JSONL results/progress, typed errors/paths/next actions and file/stdin instructions; every required lifecycle operation covered.

options.typed_subcommands: Typed lifecycle subcommands/selectors/instruction files with documented JSON final envelope and optional JSONL ending in same result. Easy simple calls; flags/schema must stay aligned.
options.json_dispatch: One versioned JSON request dispatcher from stdin/file with operation/selectors/args, same final/event envelope; optional convenience subcommands lower to that schema. Canonical machine contract; simple calls need JSON or thin sugar.
options.open: Leave this precise choice open if none meets the same outcomes; identify the needed concrete design/prerequisite in subsequent human/agent analysis. This is not rejection of the feature or permission to invent a broader obligation.

decisions.root_interpretation: Open: JSON dispatcher wins only request 3. Enumerate versioned operations/selectors/events/errors/next actions and keep any CLI sugar on the same canonical contract.

decisions.label: Composed generation/acceptance
decisions.fixed_outcome: Same capture/check/selection and retained-candidate/conflict semantics as separate calls; phases distinguish candidate-complete from accepted success, no human gate.

options.accept_option: Explicit accept=if-valid option on generate/refine, phase outcomes in structured result. Short common workflow; success state must distinguish accepted vs only generated.
options.fixed_compose: Dedicated fixed prepare-validate-accept operation with mode generate/refine and selected targets, using same lifecycle implementation. Visible schema intent; adds one command, not general workflow language.
options.open: Leave this precise choice open if none meets the same outcomes; identify the needed concrete design/prerequisite in subsequent human/agent analysis. This is not rejection of the feature or permission to invent a broader obligation.

decisions.root_interpretation: Open: accept option wins only request 3 at low confidence. Define phase outcomes and conflict/retained-candidate behavior; no human gate is required.

decisions.label: Promotion and interruption recovery
decisions.fixed_outcome: Direct-editable current primary files remain. Capture/replace freeze and build-read coordination must be explicitly designed; neither scheme has already solved final-CAS against uncooperative writers. Keep newer work on conflicts.

options.file_journal: Under specified bounded mutation freeze, one pending unit promotion record holds old/current/replacement identity and recovery phase; builders gate reads; stage/replace files and finalize only complete group. Unexpected bytes refuse recovery overwrite. Stable paths; finite file-phase journal/build gating, not multi-file FS transaction.
options.directory_stage: Dedicated unit current directory; under same freeze/gate stage complete replacement, record pending unit, retain old directory backup then rename staged to current, finalize/clear gate. Interrupted rename gap blocks readers; unexpected edits conflict. Smaller group moves; directory ownership/portability/two-rename recovery and writer protocol.
options.defer_until_writer_contract: Retain candidate-only operations and define the precise concurrent-writer/build-reader contract before selecting promotion mechanism. Avoid unsupported no-overwrite claim; leaves composed acceptance implementation temporarily unresolved, not a feature rejection.
options.open: Leave this precise choice open if none meets the same outcomes; identify the needed concrete design/prerequisite in subsequent human/agent analysis. This is not rejection of the feature or permission to invent a broader obligation.
